sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi For the Petitioners : Mr. Nilesh Kumar,
Advocate For the State : Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, A.P.P. 03/07.07.2021
This petition has been heard through Video Conferencing in view of the guidelines of the High Court taking into account the situation arising due to COVID-19 pandemic.
Mr. Nilesh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners undertakes to remove the defects within two weeks.

Mr. Nilesh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006 is special Act and unnecessarily sections of Indian Penal Code have been lodged.
According to him it is well-settled law that if Special Act is there, cognizance cannot be taken under sections of Indian Penal Code.
He submits that procedure laid down under section 42 of the Act has not been followed.
Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, learned counsel for the State shall take instruction and file counter-affidavit within four weeks.
Till then further proceeding in connection with Sukhdeonagar (Pandra O.P.) P.S. Case No. 481 of 2020 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Ranchi, shall remain stayed.
